chapter: Looking back and the lean years
title: Three years in Washington and the move to Copenhagen
summary: Washington is hard to fly out of, so he went to Copenhagen, though he still went back to New York for jobs.

story.theme_name: Going west: California and the Los Angeles scene
story.community_name: Going west: moving to and working in California

blocks.x: Now, when you were in Washington what you did then after that band-- that job ended very quickly, you went back on the road again, but you maintained Washington as your base for a couple of years---
Well, how long did we live there, Ann -- was it three?
And, that's when you moved to Copenhagen---

Yes - I was delighted to go to Copenhagen, because it seemed like - I thought Washington is a little difficult to get in and out by plane; it really is. I mean sometimes you get no flights after 11 o'clock at night in there and such things as that. And, so, it was plain that if I was to continue to do this kind of work, I'm going to move back to New York, which of course
No - no - you moved to Copenhagen.
Well, after that, but I mean then. But, I did go back to New York---
